title: The suffix question: do the sections that list R6 reach R6B?
summary: Whether the sections that list the R6 group (not R6B by name) apply to the suffixed R6B district. ZR 11-25 carries a district's regulations to the suffixed district unless the section lists separate provisions for it. The reading is of the captured text, never a program run.
what_it_is_worth: Prepared by an AI helper and recomputed by a second AI; their agreement alone is not proof. It reads the captured text of ZR 11-25 and each section's own district list. It is a draft reading, not professionally reviewed, and is not a statement that anything complies.
what_it_does_not_establish: It reads the suffix rule only; it does not decide any number for a lot.
It is not a professional or legal determination.
prepared_by: An AI helper that took no part in writing the program's rules, working only from a sealed folder of pinned law-text captures and the lot's recorded facts, with no access to the program.
checked_by: A second AI recomputed the arithmetic and the geometry independently from the same sealed folder. Agreement between two AI answers alone is not proof.
sources: The independent hand-calculation, follow-up (tables C and D): provenance/return-independent-hand-calculation-2.md
The sealed folder given to the helper: the pinned ZR captures (without the notes describing how the program encoded them) and the lot's recorded official facts, with no program access.
The law captures under docs/research/zr-snapshots/v1/, each pinned by its content digest.

citations.title: District Designations Appended with Suffixes
citations.quote: All regulations applicable to a district designation shall be applicable to such district designation appended with a suffix, except as otherwise set forth in express provisions of this Resolution

citations.title: Maximum lot coverage in R6 through R12 Districts
citations.quote: R6 R7 R8 R9 R10 R11 R12

rows.why_applies: ZR 11-25 says the regulations for a district also apply to that district with a suffix, unless a section lists separate provisions for the suffixed district. ZR 23-362 lists the R6 group (R6 R7 R8 R9 R10 R11 R12) and names no separate R6B provision, so it applies to R6B through ZR 11-25.

rows.does_not_establish: It reads the suffix rule and the section's own district list; it is not a professional determination.
